interval_hazards.meaning: vendor prior dividend basis manually rescaled, check any return interval crossing affected dividend dates

non_joinable_reference.policy: not an automatic NPORT-to-price mapping; requires historical issuer/CUSIP/event adjudication before any use

event_window_policy.historical_feature: if a lookback return interval (prior_endpoint, formation_endpoint] intersects an unverified manual_override or spin_off for same exact ticker, feature is unqualified; no_trade_day cannot be an endpoint
event_window_policy.future_label: retain formation row; if (formation_endpoint, target_endpoint] intersects unverified manual_override or spin_off, label unknown pending rights/price adjudication; no_trade_day cannot be endpoint; dates strictly inside exit_gap (last_trade,next_trade) are untradeable; merger/exit rights remain unknown even with later quote
event_window_policy.identity: exact historical ticker plus only dot/dash notation formatting allowed; COR/STI reuse hazards require issuer-level check; do not autoapply renames.csv
